cases.observed: Sensor Tower identifies Whiteout Survival as the highest-grossing mobile game globally in June 2026 and describes recurring Alliance Mobilization and Frostdragon Tyrant events.
cases.design_hypothesis: Offer cooperative alliance goals without requiring every player to be online at the same time.
testable_questions: Can casual guilds finish an event without daily attendance?
Does an opt-in event schedule reduce pressure?
limitations: A monthly worldwide revenue position is not a 2026 annual genre rank.
Publisher/event reporting does not establish user satisfaction or retention.

cases.observed: Sensor Tower describes a cooperative polar-bear expedition in a Kingshot collaboration and alliance competitions State of Power and Winter Siege.
cases.design_hypothesis: Separate collaborative progression from competitive leaderboard rewards to preserve a path for smaller alliances.
testable_questions: Can four-player teams participate without joining a large alliance?
Are rewards meaningful without leaderboard placement?
limitations: The event description is not evidence that players liked the event.
Cross-promotion effects are not measured in this report.

cases.observed: Sensor Tower reports SOL: enchant as second worldwide in June revenue growth and describes player-influenced server rules, item creation, an open player economy and offline progression.
cases.design_hypothesis: Prototype constrained player governance with rollback and economy audit logs before considering unrestricted rule changes.
testable_questions: Can governance be abused to lock out new players?
What fraction of offline rewards can be earned without payment?
limitations: Revenue growth position is not a worldwide grossing rank or genre top-100.
Features reflect an industry launch description, not independently verified gameplay.

cases.observed: Sensor Tower reports the highest global mobile revenue in August 2026 and describes a limited-time Extreme Frenzy mode with shorter cooldowns and stacking upgrades.
cases.design_hypothesis: For ARPG prototypes, experiment with temporary combat-rule variants without changing the permanent balance.
testable_questions: Does a short event mode preserve build diversity?
Can event modifiers be removed without corrupting saves?
limitations: Honor of Kings is a MOBA, not an ARPG; included only as adjacent combat/live-ops inspiration.
Highest revenue is across mobile games for August, not a 2026 annual ARPG ranking.

cases.observed: Sensor Tower lists Roblox as the most downloaded mobile game worldwide in August 2026 and cites diverse featured experiences, including fashion, tower defense and RPG content.
cases.design_hypothesis: A sandbox MVP needs discoverability and content safety before scaling creator tools.
testable_questions: Can players find suitable experiences with minimal search?
Can harmful content be reported and removed promptly?
limitations: Roblox is a multi-genre platform, not a standalone sandbox genre chart entry.
Download rank says nothing about creator economics or retention.

cases.observed: Sensor Tower describes recurring narrative merge events and collection goals that supported Gossip Harbor's August 2026 commercial performance.
cases.design_hypothesis: For city/economy simulations, evaluate optional narrative objectives without replacing meaningful production decisions.
testable_questions: Can a player ignore narrative events without an economic penalty?
Do timed collections obscure production costs?
limitations: Gossip Harbor is a merge/narrative game, not a city builder or deep economic simulation.
This is an adjacent design reference, not genre ranking evidence.
